data.title: Senior Director, Marketing Operations
data.ai_disclaimer:
Atlas HXM uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiters screen applications and match candidate qualifications to role requirements. However, all hiring decisions are made by humans.

 

As a candidate, you have the right to: (a) request that your application be reviewed without AI-assisted screening, (b) receive an explanation of how AI was used in evaluating your application, (c) contest a decision you believe was influenced by an automated process, (d) request an alternative assessment format if a disability affects your engagement with any part of our process, or (e) withdraw your application at any time. To exercise any of these rights or ask questions, contact us at people@atlashxm.com and we will respond within seven (7) business days.

 

We are committed to fair, non-discriminatory use of AI and comply with all applicable laws. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have been informed of and consent to our use of AI-assisted tools as described above.
